source: API Specification v4.0.0 (requirement/legacy/05-technical-architecture/recovery-workbench-api-specification-v4.yaml); story file v7 RWB-E1-043 sections 9, 12, 13; story file v7 RWB-E1-019 section 12 (rollback), AC4, AC5; story file v7 RWB-E1-001 section 12, X4-X8; story file v7 RWB-E1-064 sections 3, 11, 12; RWB-E1-042 spec revision 4 (output/INC-003-epic-1-RWB-E1-042/specify/spec.md) sections 11.2, 12.2, 12.5; run decisions D-RUN-10, D-RUN-11, D-RUN-12 (orchestrator, Claude Code, an AI agent; not ratified by a human)

featureFlags.rwb.p3.refdata-versions: registry branch (this story); default false, true in local profile (SPEC-018)
featureFlags.mapping: controller mapped when either flag is on; a request routed to a branch whose flag is off gets 404 MSG-P4-003; both off: no mapping

loadByTable: code with a registered ReferenceTableHandler -> registry handler path (SPEC-025, D-RUN-11)
otherwise -> registry built-in path; unknown code refused 422 MSG-P3-027 'table code is not a reference table' (SPEC-002)
dispatch.note: data_product is not refused by design: RWB-E1-001 registers its handler (D-RUN-11); until then it is an unknown code (TC-HD-03). sys_fields is registered by RWB-E1-064 (SPEC-031).

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.loader.<table>; missing key or empty value refuses (SPEC-027)

fields.file: CSV (RFC 4180, UTF-8, header row) or XLSX (first sheet) (A-21)
fields.table: one of the 12 story BR1 codes with a column definition, a registered handler code, or PARAMETER
fields.validFrom: ISO date, >= current business date (BusinessDateProvider, SPEC-017)

201.note: also returned for an identical repeat (A-06); PARAMETER repeat=true also 201

403.audit: one REFUSED REFERENCE_LOAD_AUDIT event, no user ID (SPEC-028)

409.when: approved version already has this validFrom; numbering race with different content (A-15); repeat of a handler code that supplies a repeat message (A-38)

422.when: table code, column definition, row, key or validFrom check failed (MSG-P3-027); no data rows or missing field (MSG-GEN-001); PARAMETER load with an rwb.refload.* key (MSG-P1-002, SPEC-026); handler validate failure (its own ID); detail lists every failure (max 100)

500.when: handler validate throws a non-API exception; nothing written (SPEC-025)

503.when: store unavailable or no business date (A-01, A-22)

endpoints.accessListGuard: PARAMETER load whose key column holds any rwb.refload.* key -> 422 MSG-P1-002, ParameterLoadHandler.load not called, REFUSED audit (SPEC-026, A-39, SEC-15)

endpoints.delegatesTo: ReferenceVersionRegistry#approve (calls ReferenceTableHandler#apply for a handler code; VersionDecisionRecorder) | ParameterLoadHandler#approve

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.approver.<table of loadId> (SPEC-027)

200.note: registry: repeat approval returns the same body, no change; PARAMETER branch follows RWB-E1-042 (GAP-35)

404.when: unknown loadId or branch flag off

409.when: author approves; concurrent change or handler apply failure; not approvable or validFrom passed (A-16, A-17)

503.when: store unavailable or no business date

endpoints.delegatesTo: ReferenceVersionRegistry#rollback (calls ReferenceTableHandler#onRolledBack for a handler code) | ParameterLoadHandler#rollback

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.loader.<table of loadId> (SPEC-027)

headers.Idempotency-Key: optional; accepted, not stored (state-based repeat, A-27)

200.note: repeat on a ROLLED_BACK load returns the current body, nothing written

404.when: unknown loadId or branch flag off

409.when: load not approved; not the latest approved version; handler without rollback; no earlier approved version (MSG-P3-015); concurrent change

endpoints.note: single-person action by a U holder on the table's loader list; restores a version a non-author already approved (A-27)

notBuiltHere.reason: not in story section 13 build steps; owner to be named (GAP-34, open item R18); only the Java versions() read is built here

types: ReferenceTableHandler (SPI: tableCode, validate, apply, keyColumns, repeatMessage, supportsRollback, onRolledBack, changeSummary)
RowCheckFailure (row, column, messageCode, placeholders; row 0 = file level)
publishedJavaInterfaces.signatures: story file v7 section 12 verbatim for the S7 types; ReferenceTableHandler first three methods verbatim from story file v7 RWB-E1-001 section 12; rollback per SPEC-024

types: ParameterLoadHandler (load, approve, rollback, find; obtained through ObjectProvider)
ParameterLoadResult (loadId, table, validFrom, status, rows, repeat)

audit: REFERENCE_LOAD_AUDIT structured line per load, approve, rollback, done and refused: operation, table, loadId, area, right, outcome, messageCode, traceId, changes; no user ID (SPEC-028)
problemBody: application/problem+json: type, title, status, detail, messageCode, messageTh, field, traceId (API Specification v4 Problem)
actorId: ActorIdResolver (P4 internal seam, A-07): oid claim if a UUID, else sub if a UUID, else 401 MSG-P4-001; RWB-E1-022 replaces it (SEC-16)

loadCheckOrder: L2 Reference data C -> 403 MSG-P4-002 + audit
L3 role in rwb.refload.loader.<code> (missing key refuses) -> 403 MSG-P4-002 + audit
L4 registry flag on -> else 404 MSG-P4-003
L5 file, table, validFrom present -> 422 MSG-GEN-001
L7 at least one data row -> 422 MSG-GEN-001 rows
L9 repeat (table, validFrom, content_hash): handler repeatMessage -> 409 with that message, nothing written (A-38); else 201 existing body
L10 approved twin with this validFrom -> 409 MSG-P3-027
L11 column definition and row check only if refdata.columns.<code> exists (optional for handler codes, A-37) -> 422 MSG-P3-027
L12 handler.validate -> 422 with the first failure's messageCode, placeholders and field; detail lists all (max 100)
L13 row_key unique -> 422 MSG-P3-027 'row key repeated'
L14 record VALIDATED, audit DONE with changeSummary
handlerContract.messagePassThrough: handler message IDs and ApiProblemException pass through unchanged; MSG-P3-027 only for registry checks; other exception in validate -> 500, in apply/onRolledBack -> 409 MSG-GEN-004
handlerContract.rowKey: keyColumns() joined by '|', else definition K columns, else 6-digit row number (A-37)
owningStorySupplies: handler bean behind its own flag
two parameter_catalog rows rwb.refload.loader.<code> and rwb.refload.approver.<code> (CODE_LIST, BUSINESS, GLOBAL, required=false, owner RW-RISK) in the catalog file and its own migration
its message IDs in RWB-E1-042's message catalog
handlerContract.dataProduct: RWB-E1-001: keyColumns product_code; K0-K5 messages MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P3-027, MSG-P1-003, MSG-P1-004, MSG-P1-007 pass through; repeatMessage MSG-P1-011 (409); no refdata.columns.data_product; loader RW-REFADM, approver RW-DATASTEW (A-40); no LOV-REF-TABLE change
